name: Valson Industries Limited
summary: Valson Industries Ltd. primarily specializes in the manufacturing of dyed, texturized polyester yarn. Additionally, it undertakes the processing of various cotton and fancy yarns. The company provides a diverse range of specialty texturized and twisted yarns, featuring dyed options such as cotton, spun, viscose, and chenille. Nanakchand Dayaldas Mutreja founded the enterprise in 1965, and its operational base is located in Mumbai, India.
